content.title: Collaborative Response | Role Relay to Shared Completion
content.summary: Establish a stable team inside a readable pressure field, then let members complete distinct role proofs through independent lanes. Overlap routes only after ownership is clear, and finish wide on a shared changed state. This is evidence for the existing multi-agent relay selector, not a duplicate selector.

quick_start.input_format: full team and pressure field + independent member lanes + one complete proof per role + delayed route overlap + shared wide completion
quick_start.recommended_input: Four original ceramic-factory maintenance robots with cobalt, amber, white, and red tool modules enter a stalled kiln hall through separate marked lanes. Each clears one different obstruction before all four converge around the restarted conveyor in a readable system-ready tableau.
required_anchors: Establish the full team, pressure field and available lanes before isolating any member.
Give the first active member one complete route and result before transferring focus.
Delay route overlap until every active role has been independently proved.
End wide enough to show the full team and the changed shared state.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish a stable team inside a readable pressure field, then let members complete distinct role proofs through independent lanes. Overlap routes only after ownership is clear, and finish wide on a shared changed state. This is evidence for the existing multi-agent relay selector, not a duplicate selector.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish a stable central team and a readable surrounding pressure field. Let different members enter through independent lanes and complete one role-specific proof before focus transfers. Preserve identity, origin, route and consequence for each participant; permit route overlap only after every role is legible, then return to a wide shared terminal state. The reusable mechanism is multi-agent role relay and convergent completion, not the source franchise characters, celebrity likeness, costumes, masks, fruit props, office-fight choreography or exact camera sequence.

invariants.rule: Establish the full team, pressure field and available lanes before isolating any member.
invariants.purpose: Makes later entries spatially and socially attributable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting on a close attack turns the sequence into anonymous motion.

invariants.rule: Give the first active member one complete route and result before transferring focus.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting away mid-action makes role ownership ambiguous.

invariants.rule: Assign later members distinct entry directions, tools or movement grammars.
invariants.ablation_failure: Identical routes and actions collapse the team into duplicates.

invariants.rule: Delay route overlap until every active role has been independently proved.
invariants.ablation_failure: Early crossing produces an unreadable group melee.

invariants.rule: End wide enough to show the full team and the changed shared state.
invariants.purpose: Converts separate proofs into one completed objective.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on one close-up abandons the ensemble result.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source celebrity-like martial artist appearance, exposed torso, blue shorts and exact body proportions
the source recognizable monster-franchise creature costumes, purple creature, green frog suit and melon-headed masks
the source black-suited sunglass opponents, damaged office, papers, desks and exact encirclement composition
the source kicks, punches, falls, fruit props, exact action choreography and terminal hero tableau
all source logos, watermarks, creator-specific character identities and franchise associations
